source_route: Root owns exact temporary copy and route qualification. Current StorageBox mounted/SSH probes timed out; do not retry, remount or restart. Source copy is prerequisite, not authorized by this protocol. No bulk local restore.

source.license: Tatoeba text CC BY2.0FR except explicitly marked CC0 subset; preserve per-sentence owners/IDs/links and actual source license. No audio acquired.

selection.rank: SHA256(seed|canonical_a|canonical_b), ascending; tie canonical IDs. Both metadata endpoints development, exact en/es orientation, same retained component. No pivot edges.
metadata_only_first: Inspect actual schema, corrected tag schema, split recipe, all tag names, blocked tag IDs and query plan; no raw or normalized sentence text.
Root reviews inspection hash before select. Scan direct development pair metadata, retain all both-endpoint owners/components/tags with 60000 minimum hash ranks; freeze before text.

Root reviews selection hash before fetch. Fetch only development endpoints; retain original text, tokens, codepoint/UTF16 spans, IDs, owners, tag names and tag authors/times, component, sourcehash and URLs.
selection.tag_filter: Retained policy: name LIKE '@%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%unnatural%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%incorrect%' OR lower(name) IN ('not natural','non natural','less than natural'). Either endpoint flags blocks pair; unflagged/ambiguous tags do not certify quality.
text_filters: Exact full-text expanded exclusions for both endpoint languages, using retained fingerprint.
2–60 pinned tokenizer tokens on each side, no ||| delimiter.
Deduplicate normalized en/es fingerprint pair; retain component counts separately from pair counts.
Fill 40000 in frozen rank order only. If frozen60000 insufficient, retain shortage and stop; no output-driven widening or sample change.
selection.license_policy: Conservative retained Tatoeba text attribution license; no inference that an endpoint is CC0 without exact supporting record. Preserve unknown/blank owners, do not silently invent attribution.

tag_policy_source.interpretation: Existing conservative editorial policy, not a guarantee every @ tag indicates incorrect text. Root must inspect actual matching tag names before selection.

control.identity: Exact retained 40000 PGV EN–ES pairs, text, directional alignments and grow-diag-final-and result in input-freeze.json. Do not filter/retrain control.
control.overlap_audit: Before interpreting targets, audit retained PGV full endpoint fingerprints against expanded exclusions and Tatoeba chosen fingerprints; report same-component/owner concentration and token-length distributions. PGV exposure differences remain an explicit confound.
confounds: Contributor-authored Tatoeba sentence references are not conversational frequency or bilingual gold. PGV is published news/article alignment.
40k pair counts do not match total tokens, component diversity, contributors, sentence length, quality flags or historical exposure.
PGV lacks dependable article IDs; components are not independent-document certificates.
The subsequent parallel review sentences come from original control training; expanded exclusions apply prospectively only to Tatoeba.

audit.owner_semantics: PGV owner is synthetic Global Voices contributors; PGV archive#tu provenance, not contributor identity. Do not compare distinct owner counts directly to Tatoeba usernames.

matched_recipe.execution: Deferred until metadata/selection/subset receipts and commands reviewed. No corpus/model run authorized now.
matched_recipe.aligner: Reuse exact pinned fast_align/toolchain hashes; forward+reverse five iterations -d -o -v -I 5; reverse adds -r. One new Tatoeba fit only, no PGV retraining.
matched_recipe.symmetrization: grow-diag-final-and only for primary matched comparison; reuse retained PGV output, no grid.
matched_recipe.phrases: Same existing extract_phrases.py geometry: source max8 targetmax12, aligned interval consistency and all bounded unaligned boundary expansions, punctuation restrictions. Preserve all target variants; do not call consistency construction completeness.
matched_recipe.source_only_first: Report raw matched selected-key availability/length/component support for same3000unigram+5000multiword keys before targetquality review. Do not tune keys from Tatoeba outputs.
matched_recipe.ranking: Unchanged existing joint distinct-component count descending, bidirectional lexical score descending, stable target identity tie; retain all alternatives. No sameface rescue or target patches.

semantic_packet.ranking: Within availability bucket and length, ascending SHA256(seed|availability|length|normalized_source_key), key tie. Shared8keys produce both corpus proposals16; each corpus-only8 produces8, totalmax32. Freeze exact keys before target packet assembly. No quota backfill if short.
semantic_packet.availability: At least one grow-diag-final-and retained phrase variant for a frozen8000sourcekey. Availability is source-key output metadata, not reviewed correctness.
semantic_packet.target_choice: Use predeclared count/lexical-score/target-ID ranking, preserve all variants. Retain original full source and target evidence sentences for each nominated top variant and all emitted scopes; no clipping to nominated word.
semantic_packet.evidence_choice: For chosen variant, ascending component then canonical pair identity among retained supporting records; preserve total support and all provenance links.
semantic_packet.review: Author and root freeze labels separately before joining. No fresh-independence or population claims; oldreview/exposure membership remains explicit. Distinguish complete constructions from merely alignment-consistent ngrams.

matched_recipe.projection: No new app projection/density/known-state grid here; defer exact whole-output policy to root after source-only inventory.

extraction_bounds.host: consolidated production temporary staging only, after root explicit execution authorization
extraction_bounds.failure: Retain per-stage failures and partial artifacts. Each stage directory create-only; no blind retry. No network in extractor; no old SSHFS repair, new VM, local bulk restore, or runtime activation.

remaining_review_prerequisites: Qualified source route plus verified exact temporary source copy.
Exactsubset40k and PGV overlap/domain audit, then root review of execution commands/resources; target-review selection is already frozen here.
